headline: Neneng Weakens Into Remnant Low East of Taiwan as Luzon Weather Clears
seoTitle: TD Neneng Degrades into Remnant Low; Luzon Weather Clears | FMB News
seoDescription: PAGASA confirmed that Tropical Depression Neneng weakened into a remnant low east of Taiwan on August 20 as heavy rainfall warnings over Luzon were lifted.
deck: PAGASA confirmed the cyclone's dissipation and a broader return to fairer weather across Luzon, with only localized thunderstorms remaining possible.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: PAGASA confirmed Thursday afternoon that Tropical Depression Neneng had weakened into a remnant low-pressure area over waters east of Taiwan.
The approved FMB News evening package says the system had decoupled from the Southwest Monsoon, allowing heavy-rain warnings over western Luzon to be lifted and skies to gradually clear.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Neneng had enhanced monsoon rainfall over Luzon during the preceding days. Its weakening reduced the atmospheric pull that had been feeding widespread rain into the western side of the country.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The end of the cyclone's influence supports flood recovery and transport normalization, although localized thunderstorms and residual floodwater can still pose hazards.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: PAGASA expects generally fairer weather with isolated afternoon or evening thunderstorms. Continue monitoring local advisories in areas where rivers, drainage systems and saturated slopes are still recovering.
